the novel triazolo[3,4-d][1,2]-benzotriazines and triazolotrirazines were designed and synthesized and evaluated for their in vitro DPP4 inhibition activity and the most promising compound (15q) was selected for further in vitro and in vivo anti-diabetes activity.

the design and synthesis of novel series of triazol[5,1- c][1,2,4]triazines as DPP- 4 inhibitors.
the synthesis and evaluation of a series of novel DPP- 4 inhibitors and their anti-diabetic activity.

the design, synthesis and in vitro evaluation of novel triazolo[4,3-b]pyridazine and triazolotetrazine derivatives as potent and selective DPP-4 (dipeptidyl peptydase-4) inhibitors for the treatment of type 2 diabetes.

the designed and synthesized derivatives are potent DPP-4 and DPP-8/9 dual inhibitors and can be considered as lead compounds for further optimization.

we have successfully identified a novel and moderately selective DPP-4 hit molecule with potential anti-diabetic activity.
the present study has provided a novel class of triazolopyrimidine derivatives as DPP-IV inhibitors and one of the derivatives 15q showed significant in vivo anti-diabetes activity in animal model.

we have designed and synthesized novel triazolo[4,3-c][1,4]thiazine derivatives which are DPP-4 selective and moderately effective as anti-diabetic agents.
